profile.overview: Law is a close range, poking-based, slide archetype character with strong neutral tools and strong block punishment. A legacy character with traditionally challenging execution, he is very accessible this time around and is suitable for anyone looking to live out their Bruce Lee fantasy.
strengths: Lightning-quick: Some of the fastest panic moves in the game, including d+2,3 and 1,1,1.
Slide to the Left: One of the better crouch mixups in the game.

Fiery Action: Heat engagers include a i10 CH string, a i14 CH string, and a low crush. Nunchuck moves become more rewarding on hit and safer on block, and Law's Heat Smash is one of the fastest in the game.
weaknesses: Baby Steps: One of the few characters with a slower backdash.
Quick Burner: Combos become more complicated during heat if heat consumption is a concern.
Up Close and Personal: Only strong at a close range.
